newsitem.title: THAILAND: Bidaya chosen as new Thai finance minister-official.
newsitem.headline: Bidaya chosen as new Thai finance minister-official.

text.p: Thanong Bidaya has been chosen as the new Thai finance minister and his name has been submitted to King Bhumibol Adulyadej for official appointment, acting Finance Minister Thawatvong Na Chiangmai said on Friday.
"It has been decided to propose Thanong Bidaya to the King for appointment as new finance minister," he told reporters.
Thanong, 50, is president of the Thai Military Bank Plc, and will replace Amnuay Viravan who resigned on Thursday. Thanong is close with Prime Minister Chavalit Yongchaiyudh.
The acting finance minister's statement confirmed earlier news reports that Thanong was the top candidate for the post after other economic heavyweights had turned down the job offer.
Amnuay quit after running into policy differences with political rivals in Chavalit's coalition government over the management of Thailand' ailing economy.

The Thai government is grappling with measures to guide the country out of its worst economic crisis in over a decade. Thanong will be the sixth finance minister that Thailand has had since 1995 under three administrations.
